_comment: Manually researched Tabit restaurants — Tabit has no public search API (unlike Ontopo, which is searched live), so this file is the only way to auto-fill Tabit reservation links. Add an entry here, matching the exact restaurant name as saved in the app's list, and the next scheduled run of apply-reservation-links.yml will fill it in for every account that has that restaurant, without needing to touch the pencil icon.
